**Order filled:** 40 shares of AAPL at $222.75 = $8,910.00 (within the $10,000/order cap; total today $8,910 of the $20,000 daily budget; no money left the account).

**Summary:** I researched Apple's most recent results — the fiscal 2024 fourth quarter, ended September 28, 2024 — via Apple's newsroom press release, which reported quarterly revenue of $94.9 billion (up 6% year over year) and, for fiscal 2024 as a whole, **total net sales of $391.0 billion** with net income of $93.7 billion, or $6.08 per diluted share (including a one-time $10.2 billion income tax charge). I cross-checked that annual revenue figure against Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (filed 2024-11-01), which reports revenue of $391,035 million, confirming the press release. The growth trajectory (6% YoY quarterly growth, services strength, and a tax-charge-only drag on earnings) supports continued ownership, so I bought 40 shares of AAPL with a limit price of $222.75, essentially at the quoted market (last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72) as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC — an outlay of $8,910, comfortably inside both the per-order and daily limits. Key figures relied on: fiscal 2024 total net sales of $391,035 million (USD millions).
